recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further core FHIR source change is needed for FHIR-36067 unless a future OO decision changes the Observation component value/dataAbsentReason exclusivity rule.
issue_request: FHIR-36067 was an Applied/Persuasive with Modification OO change request for FHIR-core Observation. It reported that a blood pressure Observation validating against the bp profile could pass when systolic and diastolic components each had both component.valueQuantity and component.dataAbsentReason, and the accepted resolution was to add an invariant to Observation.component.value[x] analogous to the existing Observation.value[x] rule.
initial_application: The issue was applied in git by e832cabab82fa5c30949380ede5d2eef80f5194c, which added obs-10 to source/observation/structuredefinition-Observation.xml. The Jira comment later cited PR #3351 commit 7522e5c98a262dd2a46575a4fe324e849e7c661d as the build application record.
additional_context: Observation is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini, and StructureDefinition/bp is included by the Observation vital signs implementation guide. The later same-change-family issue FHIR-50145 clarified obs-6/obs-10 descriptions, added missing obs-10 condition tags, and added obs-10 invariant tests in 58e1e1353018b34133ee9ad8cb4d5b6768eb04ac. FHIR-50145 is already represented on the combined branch by audit commit 4d2b1aaf089f44790e86ed7eafd9d5e39f0f52d8, so it was not republished here. Community searches found one early OO minutes page asking for broader discussion of FHIR-36067 and no conflicting Zulip evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current Observation source defines obs-10 as an error invariant with expression component.empty() or component.where(dataAbsentReason.exists()).all(value.empty()), and the relevant Observation.component, Observation.component.value[x], and Observation.component.dataAbsentReason elements carry obs-10 condition tags. The current invariant tests include the blood-pressure-style failing XML example with both component.valueQuantity and component.dataAbsentReason.

related_jiras.note: Later Applied technical correction completed obs-10 descriptions, condition tags, and invariant tests after the FHIR-36067 application; already audited on the combined branch as 4d2b1aaf089f44790e86ed7eafd9d5e39f0f52d8.
